## Life Summary

William Humphrey Parker was born on 17 July 1850 at Ragged Hill, Mossblown, Ayrshire, Scotland. He emigrated to South Australia, where he married Hannah Baker on 21 August 1878 at the residence of the bride's parents, Virginia, South Australia.

He was a farmer and settled in the Long Plains area. His children included Sophia (who married Frank Lindsay Lawrie) and William Henry (who married Caroline Edna Lawrie), creating a double union between the Parker and Lawrie families.

He died on 18 February 1926 at Lower Mitcham, South Australia, and was buried at Mitcham General Cemetery.
